svg.text: power limit (TDP): 700 W SXM · 350 W PCIe
8 GPCs × 18 SMs = 144 SMs on the die. Only 132 (SXM5) or 114 (PCIe) are enabled;
the rest are fused off for manufacturing yield.
L2: 50 MB exposed · shared cache; cost depends on pattern and load
Cache lines contain sectors · supports global atomics · replacement policy affects reuse
